items.stem: How many technical accreditations must be completed in the Partner Portal?

options.text: Five, validated by a Glean Partner Manager.
None; the agent builds replace coursework.

items.stem: How many production-ready agents must a partner build?

options.text: Five, each meeting the per-agent criteria.

items.stem: Which capability is required of at least one agent, not all five?

options.text: Using loops to process a collection.
Explicit error handling with a defined fallback.

items.stem: What evidence is required for each agent's business value?

options.text: A written outline of business impact and why a Glean Agent was the best solution.
A verbal summary on the validation call.

items.stem: Who can pursue the Agent Building Competency?

options.text: All registered Glean Partners, including resell, services, and ISV or product partners.
